Name: Lover--GingerIslandTravel
Author: lud1314
Description:
[size=4][b]描述[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Bring your spouse to live on Ginger Island. Choose to stay for one day, one week, one month, or permanently. Manage their stay through Willy. [/color]

[size=4][b]安装说明[/b][/size]
[*]Install [b]SMAPI 4.0+[/b] [/*]
[*]Move the mod folder into your
[code]Stardew Valley\Mods[/code]directory [/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI


[size=4][b]主要特点[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Spouse Island Travel[/b] — Bring your spouse to Ginger Island [/*]
[*][b]Flexible Stays[/b] — 1 day, 1 week, 1 month, or permanent [/*]
[*][b]Willy Management[/b] — Check, extend, or end their stay [/*]
[*][b]Island Schedule[/b] — Your spouse follows a daily routine [/*]
[*][b]Festival Return[/b] — Automatically returns for festivals [/*]
[*][b]Spouse Dialogue[/b] — Unique dialogue while on the island [/*]
[*][b]Multiplayer Support[/b] — Works in multiplayer[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]要求[/b][/size][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Not compatible with mods that allow marriage to multiple NPCs.[/b] [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Not compatible with mods that allow marriage to NPCs who are not vanilla marriage candidates.[/b] [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]The Ginger Island farmhouse must be repaired before using this mod.[/b][/color]


[size=4][b]特别鸣谢[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Thank you[/color]


[/*]
